data: {{Top}} {{Character |type=Galactic Republic |image=[[File:OonliCharum.jpg]] |name=Oonli Charum |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' |gender= |pronouns= |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Dark]] |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Republic]] *[[Galactic Senate]] |masters= |apprentices= }} '''Oonli Charum''' was a [[human]] who represented the [[Sumitra sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. Their views were often in step with those of Senator [[Worus Rayencourt]] of the [[Thusa sector]], who advocated for stricter senatorial supervision of the [[Jedi Order]]. Charum wore braids that honored [[Thustra]], one of their constituent worlds. {{Char-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{Acolyte|The Acolyte (episode)}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/ilm-the-acolyte-vfx-interview|text=Lightsabers & Magic: Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy on The Acolyte's Creatures and Weapons of the Jedi}} {{Po}} *{{SWYouTube|9ajCIM6U5UA|The Acolyte | The Costumes of The Acolyte | Disney+}} {{Video}} *''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' {{1stID|Oonli Charum}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Charum, Oonli}} [[Category:Galactic Republic senators during the High Republic Era]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
